D2.title: Preflop raise size
D2.reason: Home games call a lot, so raise bigger than online: 3 to 5 big blinds, plus 1 big blind for each player who limped.

D3.title: Re-raise size
D3.reason: Re-raise to 3 to 4 times the raise when you will act after them, and 4 to 5 times when you will act first after the flop.

D4.title: Continuation bet size
D4.reason: Bet small, a quarter to a third of the pot, on a dry board. Bet big, two thirds to three quarters, on a wet board where draws are possible, so they pay to chase. Half the pot sits between the two, so it is not the answer for either.

D5.title: Value bet against players who call too much
D5.reason: Players who call too much call a big bet almost as often as a small one, so bet big with a strong hand: at least two thirds of the pot, and up to one and a half pots.
